cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
mkdir -p backup_acct; cp classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py runs.json backup_acct/
for f in classic_acct.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL $f; exit 1; }
done
for f in classic_acct.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do cp /tmp/new_$f $f; done; chown tbot:tbot classic_*.py
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 12
echo active=$(systemctl is-active classicbot)
S=$(date +%s.%N); curl -s -m 120 localhost:8091/api/runs > /tmp/acc.json; E=$(date +%s.%N)
python3 - <<'P'
import json,sys
try:
    d=json.load(open('/tmp/acc.json'))
except Exception as e:
    print('BAD_JSON',e); sys.exit(0)
a=d['accounts']
for k in ('me','bot','both'):
    x=a[k]; print(k, {kk:vv for kk,vv in x['account'].items() if kk in ('equity','balance','taken','skipped','status')}, x['signals'])
print('tracks',sorted(set(r['track'] for r in d['runs'])))
P
echo time=$(python3 -c "print(round($E-$S,1))")
if ! python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('/tmp/acc.json'))" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo ROLLBACK; cp backup_acct/classic_strategy.py backup_acct/classic_panel.py backup_acct/classic_pos_html.py . ; rm -f classic_acct.py; chown tbot:tbot classic_*.py; systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 5; systemctl is-active classicbot
fi
journalctl -u classicbot -n 15 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -i "error\|Traceback" | head -5
